```python
from griffe.loader import GriffeLoader

loader = GriffeLoader()

# Load package at v1.0.0 and HEAD using git-aware loading
old = loader.load("mypkg", ref="v1.0.0")
new = loader.load("mypkg", ref="HEAD")

# Iterate over breakages and print each one
for breakage in new.get_breakages(old):
    print(breakage)
```
